finalText:
**Big but mostly mechanical.** 1291 spots across 94 files. About 1078 rename safely.

Five places must keep `account_id`:

| Keep as-is | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | public field, breaks clients |
| `lib/serialize.js` | feeds that public field |
| `migrations/*.sql` | already ran in production |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | regenerated, edits lost |
| 125 SQL lines in repos | column name, needs a migration |
